column1: # The message form's bytes(N) element-kind corpus (docs/SPEC-TABLES.md 3.3,
# "bytes(N) and [..N]uint8 are the same kind"): a writer built from the named
# schema beside this file saves one M whose b holds the elements, and the
# reader (reader.schema, b bytes(8)) loads the batch after that writer's
# elements: the Ruby array b holds on the writer.
# expect: loaded <b as hex> or refused.
# reason: the Ruby leg's refusal reason (per-language diagnostic detail, "-"
#   for a load); conformance compares only the verdict.
